result.finding: H1 primary fit (approach [7]). H1 analysis set: the 404 chemicals passing approaches [1]-[6] restricted to measured log Kow in [1, 6] inclusive: n = 341 chemicals (log Kow 1.06 to 5.96). OLS of per-chemical mean log BCF on measured log Kow, one point per chemical, unweighted, with intercept: log BCF = a + b log Kow with a = -0.806328, b = 0.768932 (SE 0.028770), 95% CI of b [0.712342, 0.825522] (t distribution, 339 df, t = 1.966986), R^2 = 0.678161. Band margin m = min(b - 0.7, 1.0 - b) = 0.068932. Result.point = m, Result.effect_size = b, Result.ci = 95% CI of b. Pre-registered bearing: supports if m >= 0, refutes otherwise -> supports. SciPy linregress on the same points gives the same slope, intercept and R^2.
